verdict.rationale: A training-data opt-out is a fair privacy question for an AI customer-service SaaS like Fin, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions an opt-out, a no-training commitment, or data-usage controls. The trust page only makes general claims about compliance standards and tools to deploy AI "within your own boundaries", which say nothing specific about model training, and the "Train Fin on your knowledge" pages describe grounding Fin in customer content rather than limiting how data is used.
